label: Coding
summary: Nine stages. One reviewed pull request.
note: Illustrated workflow · historical coding evidence below.

stages.name: Inbox
stages.title: A task, not another chat.
stages.body: The request becomes a task folder. Its inputs stay with it through every handoff.
stages.sample: Build a scriptable screenshot CLI. Read every note, not just the first page.

stages.name: Brainstorm
stages.title: Make the request precise.
stages.body: Questions become requirements before implementation starts.
stages.sample: JSON output. Stable exit codes. Complete note results.

stages.name: Plan
stages.title: Save the approach.
stages.body: Scope and checks become an artifact the next agent can read.
stages.sample: Reuse the API. Build the CLI. Check pagination and error handling.

stages.name: Execute
stages.title: Work in a separate worktree.
stages.body: The builder receives the plan and works on the task branch.
stages.sample: Plan → implementation → commit. The task keeps its prior documents.

stages.name: Open PR
stages.title: Open a draft for inspection.
stages.body: The change and its context are linked in a draft pull request.
stages.sample: A draft PR is a review surface, not a claim that the work is finished.

stages.name: Review
stages.title: A finding sends it back.
stages.body: In the recorded Screenote task, review caught notes disappearing after screenshot 100.
stages.sample: Finding: fetch every page, not just the first 100 screenshots.

stages.name: Artifacts
stages.title: Keep the evidence.
stages.body: Checks and supporting artifacts make the result inspectable.
stages.sample: Targeted API and Go checks passed. The full Rails suite was blocked by missing libvips.

stages.name: Finalize
stages.title: Package the result.
stages.body: The PR, review history, and handoff notes stay together.
stages.sample: Reviewed changes and their evidence. Ready for a human to inspect.

stages.name: Done
stages.title: A reviewed pull request.
stages.body: The task is archived with its artifacts. Completion does not promise an automatic merge.
stages.sample: The recorded Screenote PR was later merged. Inspect the historical result below.

route.title: The builder takes it back.
route.body: The finding travels back with the same task. Earlier requirements and the plan remain saved.
route.sample: Fix: fetch all pages and surface real API errors.

route.title: Check the fix again.
route.body: The change returns to review. Bounded review can still stop for human intervention.
route.sample: The pagination fix is rechecked before the workflow moves on.

label: Content
summary: Six stages. A finished article and its sources.
note: Illustrative run · requires the configured research and writing skills.

stages.name: Inbox
stages.title: Start with a brief.
stages.body: A document workflow starts with a task folder, just like coding.
stages.sample: Explain how to choose a backup strategy for a small team.

stages.name: Research
stages.title: Collect the source material.
stages.body: The research stage saves findings for the outline.
stages.sample: Source notes: recovery objectives, retention, and restore testing.

stages.name: Outline
stages.title: Give the document a shape.
stages.body: The outline makes the intended structure explicit.
stages.sample:
1. Recovery needs
2. Backup choices
3. Test a restore

stages.name: Draft
stages.title: Write from saved inputs.
stages.body: The writer receives research.md and outline.md. They remain available if this attempt stops.
stages.sample: A first draft built from the brief, source notes, and agreed structure.

stages.name: Critique
stages.title: Make the feedback durable.
stages.body: The built-in content flow writes an editorial critique before its final writing stage.
stages.sample: Clarify the difference between a successful backup and a tested restore.

stages.name: Done
stages.title: A document, not a pull request.
stages.body: The final writer produces article.md with supporting artifacts still attached.
stages.sample: A finished article, its sources, outline, draft, and editorial critique.

label: Research
summary: Two agent stages. One explicit human decision.
note: Custom workflow example · not a recorded run or built-in integration.

stages.name: Research
stages.title: Collect evidence.
stages.body: This custom example uses the same agent-stage primitives as the built-ins.
stages.sample: Compare backup approaches. Record sources, limitations, and unresolved questions.

stages.name: Synthesize
stages.title: Make a report to review.
stages.body: The synthesis stage produces a report from the saved research.
stages.sample: Recommendation: start with recovery needs. Include source limitations and a restore-test plan.

stages.name: Human review
stages.title: The workflow waits for you.
stages.body: Read the report, then approve it or send it back for revision. This demo does not publish or send anything.
stages.sample: Review report.md. Approve the handoff, or request clearer source limitations.
